recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17902 unless a future Patient Care decision reopens the broader Communication public-health examples.
issue_request: FHIR-17902 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for FHIR-core Communication. It asked to correct examples that implied Communication was for notifying a public health agency of an initial case report, and instead describe public health agency communication or response to a provider/reporter in response to a case report while pointing organized initial case reports to Composition.
initial_application: Git commit 39c5af7f1715a0912da1baaac6cb4e5d530bcdd3 applied GF#17902 by changing source/communication/communication-introduction.xml to a response-from-public-health example and adding the Composition boundary paragraph. It also updated the then-current communication spreadsheet description. The spreadsheet source no longer exists, and the current structuredefinition source now carries the equivalent provider/reporter response wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists communication=Communication as an active resource. Later same-resource work for FHIR-13389, FHIR-40760, and FHIR-28235 changed broader Communication guidance and timing/boundary language, but preserved the FHIR-17902 public-health response and Composition distinction. Community searches found no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion that conflicts with the Jira/source evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/communication/structuredefinition-Communication.xml contains the public health agency communication to a provider/reporter in response to a case report, and source/communication/communication-introduction.xml contains the public-health response use case plus the Composition boundary note for initial case reports.
